propositions: Destructive repair must acquire and own a durable pause before mutation, replacing GitHub-only workflow disable/enable with provider-neutral CAS-written pause ref.
Repair initialization is fail-closed: missing git email, missing or foreign pre-existing pause, or pause creation uncertainty aborts before any mutation.
Pause cleanup uses CAS on the observed OID and only clears if the stored reason matches the invocation token; cleanup failure or token mismatch leaves the pause for operator recovery.
The reconciler lock check runs in-flight after pause ownership and aborts if held, corrupt, or uncertain; destructive mutation only proceeds after both safety checks succeed.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair use the same shared repair-owned pause contract and support local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments without requiring a gh binary.
